name: Dark-Alarm
tagline: Wake up on time with powerful alarms and fun wake-up challenges.
description: Dark Alarm is a free and open-source alarm clock designed to help you wake up on time. It works completely offline, lets you create multiple alarms, customize alarm sounds, repeat schedules, labels, and volume settings. To prevent oversleeping, it includes wake-up challenges such as math problems before you can stop the alarm. No ads, no tracking, and your data stays on your device.
